summary: POST /api/auth/login returned HTTP 500 with ValueError: password cannot be longer than 72 bytes raised inside passlib bcrypt backend detection.
root_cause: Unpinned bcrypt resolved to 5.x on build; passlib 1.7.4 is incompatible with bcrypt>=4.1/5.x backend detection. Reproducible on a fresh image build despite the service having booted 6h earlier.
recovery: Pinned bcrypt==4.0.1 under passlib[bcrypt] in platform/backend/requirements.txt (local and VPS), rebuilt platform-api, re-seeded admin hash with the fixed lib. Login returned 200 with token.
prevention: Pin transitive crypto deps in every service that hashes passwords; add auth login to the staging smoke checklist.
